status: authored 2026-10-09 as one of the walk-through halls (docs/world-building/GYM_WALKTHROUGH.md); offline checks only (tools/gym_arenas.py check, tools/gym_arenas_audit.py, tools/gym_trainers.py check). Nothing of it has been built in a world or seen in a running game.
name: The Reed House
reading: Koga's town is a fen-edge watch town whose trackers read the marsh for anyone passing unseen (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym5_town: mangrove, mud brick, packed mud, bamboo, dark oak; its signature dressing is a board of cast prints). One house, walked through: in at the jetty door from the boardwalk's end, past the trackers' board of casts, up the reed stair onto the drying loft, out along one of three plank walks over the flood to the steeping vats (they look alike; only the west one breathes: soul sand's bubbles, a green glow low in its water), down into it and out through its mouth, a tunnel under the screen, to surface in the settling pool; then in at the door in the dividing wall to the Tracking Floor, which is last night's range under the old house, turned to stand at the lot's level: a low mud-brick floor in half-light, mangrove roots grown down through the roof, a trail of prints, and woven reed screens that hide the far end until the last turn, where the range opens and the blind shows with Koga half in shadow in it, three courses above the floor. Out past him by the iron door in the west wall (its button inside), or back the way you came, through the vat and the pool.

leader.seat_why: in the deck of the blind (y119, floor y116 + 3), on the range's axis (x4581, the middle of the Pokemon's column), two in from the front of the hide. THE ONE SOURCE of Koga's seat (tools/gym_arenas.py leader_seats).

bounds_why: the gym lot exactly in x and z (data/placements.json gym5_town gym5_gym rect 4574..4606 x 2463..2495, level 116), y112 (the old house's flue sump and tanks, the lowest cell of its bounds) to y142 (its ridge), so the hall's first part and the stone under the pad overwrite every cell of the Reed House's bounds [4576, 112, 2465, 4604, 142, 2493]. Inside the gym_koga zone [4568, 2456, 4607, 2495] on every side.

replaces.why: what stood before this hall and is taken down by it, measured from the records that built it, never guessed. The arena is data/gym_arenas/gym5.json as it was built and applied to staging on 2026-10-09 (schema gym_arena/1, git history: The Tracking Floor under the Reed House); the building is data/gym_buildings/gym5.json, kept, now superseded_by this file. Below the lot the takedown function (gym5_takedown) fills the arena's bounds and the descent's part under the pad with stone; above it this hall's first part clears the lot.

through_building.why: the stair tower's part under the old building's bounds (last night's arena record's through_building box [4598, 99, 2487, 4603, 134, 2492], split here): walls, ring and treads from the range's floor up through the two natural courses, back to rock by the takedown

the same box above the pad: the old house's flood-hall corner, taken down by this hall's own first part (the lot cleared from y116). Its middle, y112..115, lies inside the old building's bounds and is written by this hall's stone fill under the pad; it is left out of the list because tools/gym_arenas.py hall_checks counts a cell of both the takedown and the old building's bounds as never written by the hall

battle.why: Cobblemon Battle Positions (a Cobbleverse dependency, already installed): its search finds these from the challenger's feet and sends both Pokemon to them. The Pokemon blocks sit one under the floor's top course, so spawnHeightOffset 2.0 stands each Pokemon ON the floor; the trainer stand is under the deck one in front of the seat, behind the packed-mud face, so Koga steps to the front of the hide. Koga's Pokemon is 5.5 from the dais face (clear radius 3.13, Drapion's model sweep: 2.4 to spare); the two Pokemon are 5 apart (Drapion's hitbox is 2.02 wide); the challenger stands 3 behind their own.

entry.why: street is the fen lane north of the lot, east of the door (ground y115 at x4596 z2462, tools/ground.py rounded; the boardwalk's end at x4590 is the town prep's, not modelled here): a player steps up onto the jetty apron (row z2463, paving y116) and along it to the door at x4590..4592. entry.floor is the Tracking Floor's first cell inside its door in the dividing wall (x4588, z2492..2493): 25.9 from Koga, farther than rctmod's forceBattleMaxDistance + 1 = 17, so the player stands on the floor, behind two screens, before he can call the fight. Measured by a breadth-first walk of this record's model (the builder's own walk rules: step, jump one, fall; no swimming or ladders, so the pool is left by its silt bank): 45 moves from the street cell to entry.floor and 70 to the challenger's stand; up 3 to the loft, then down to the vat's floor and back up to the dry yard.

exit.why: the door past the leader: an iron door in the west wall, in front of the blind, opened by the stone button on the wall inside it; out onto the lot's west margin. Nothing outside opens it, so it cannot be used to reach Koga past the vestibule, the loft and the pool. Or back the way you came: the vat, its mouth and the pool are swum both ways.

challenge_spawner.why: declared because tools/gym_arenas.py check demands it of any leader outside single_leader.rollout (hall included, though SCHEMA.md says a hall does not use it): the Challenge cell of last night's range, two west of its seat. The takedown fills that arena with stone, so the restore is stone; a hall's seat function does not read this field. data/challenge_mode.json bosses.kanto_koga.spawner.at is now beside the new seat, (4579, 119, 2467).

battle.why: Cobblemon Battle Positions (a Cobbleverse dependency, already installed), as the range set them, turned north-south and moved with the floor: Koga's Pokemon 5.5 from the blind's face (clear radius 3.13, Drapion's model sweep), the challenger's 5 behind it, the challenger 3 behind their own. One under the floor's top course, so spawnHeightOffset 2.0 stands each on the floor; the trainer stand is under the deck one in front of the seat, so Koga steps to the front of the hide.

blocks_why: the town's own palette (TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym5_town: mangrove, mud brick, packed mud, bamboo) and nothing that is a spawn condition but water (data/spawn_blocks.json: water is one; the flood, the vats, the tunnel and the pool, 454 source cells (counted from the model) and 15 waterlogged ladder cells, lie wholly inside the gym_koga spawn-free zone [4568, 2456, 4607, 2495], as the old house's did). No grass, leaves, sand or carpet. Bamboo planks are a solid cube, so each woven-reed screen blocks sight in the world as well as in the check (bamboo mosaic and mangrove roots, which last night's range used, are not in tools/gym_trainers.py's movement-model tables, so planks and muddy roots stand in for them).
